regions.text: その場合目約として立てられはしなかつたが、しかも目前たり得べきやうなものである。

quote.translation: It is something that was not set up as a purpose in the case concerned, yet is nonetheless of a kind that could have been a purpose.

regions.text: 目的々積極的偶然には特に一種の「目前なき目前」が強い陰影を投げかけてゐるのが常である。

quote.translation: In positive teleological contingency in particular, a kind of "purpose without purpose" usually casts a strong shadow.

regions.text: ベルクッンの語を借りて云へばそこに「善然（mbongenic）または感気」（mmauvaisgcnie）が働いてゐるかのやうな親を呈するのでぁ（Bergson,LEvolutioncreatri

quote.translation: To borrow Bergson's words, it looks as though a "good genius" (un bon génie) or an "evil genius" (un mauvais génie) were at work (Bergson, L'Évolution créatrice, 25 éd., p. 254; Les deux sources de la morale et de la religion, 7 éd., p. 152-157).
The death in action of Major-General Kondratenko seems, to our army, like a purpose aimed at by a good genius, and to the Russian army like a purpose aimed at by an evil genius.

regions.text: °コントラテンコ少將の戦死について云へば、我軍にとつては普靈が目指した目の如く露西亞軍にとつては慈靈が目指した目的の如くに思ばれる。

quote.translation: In the example of the broadcast programmes, likewise, what happened can be thought of as the purposive act of an evil genius from the side of the Tokyo Broadcasting Station and as the purposive act of a good genius from the side of the Osaka Broadcasting Station.

regions.text: また放番組の例について云へば東京放送局にとつては悪愛の目的々行為の如く大阪放送局にとつては善靈の目的々行橋の如くに考へられる。もちろん目約々消極偶然にあつても、目の非存在が主張される以上は、何等かの「目なき目駒があつて、それに對して「目倒なきことが、目的の非存在が特に主張されるのである。

quote.translation: Of course, in negative teleological contingency too, insofar as the non-existence of a purpose is asserted, there is some "purpose without purpose", and it is over against this that the condition of being "without purpose", the non-existence of purpose, is specifically asserted.

regions.text: 然しながらその場合に目的の非存在そのものの把握に一切の重踏が置かれてある限り、目々偶然は滑極性に於てあらはれるのである。

quote.translation: In that case, however, the whole emphasis falls on grasping the non-existence of purpose itself, and so long as this is so, teleological contingency appears in the form of negativity.

regions.text: それに反して、目々積極偶然にあつては特に「目防なき目釣」の存在が積極約に强調され

quote.translation: In positive teleological contingency, by contrast, it is the existence of "purpose without purpose" that is positively emphasised and witnessed.
